title: Code and frozen results for: Tracing high transductive cohort AUC to same-site supervision in a site-aware population GNN for multisite fMRI
description: Reproducibility software and frozen analysis artifacts for the study "Tracing high transductive cohort AUC to same-site supervision in a site-aware population GNN for multisite fMRI". The release includes the deterministic evaluation harness, recovered per-seed outer-fold generation partitions, the reconstructed mean-fold aggregation reference, the frozen result registry, redistributed out-of-fold and leave-one-site-out prediction artifacts for release-backed conditions, derived statistics, and registry/provenance validation tools. Historical scalar rows without redistributed backing predictions are explicitly identified in the registry. No primary imaging data are redistributed.
